prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: picorv32-fetch-misalign
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 675d084aed972945
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Trace shows TRAP: fetch misalign addr low bits nonzero with tohost FAIL 0xdead. mem_la_addr drives low bits as 2'b10 instead of expected 2'b00, so every fetch is misaligned. Root cause is picorv32.v:382 which builds {next_pc[31:2]+mem_la_firstword_xfer,2'b10} and {reg_op1[31:2],2'b10}.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 675d084aed972945 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
